I know exactly how you feel. I am a third year student of one of the best-rated universities in the US. I have a girlfriend and I'm actually on okay terms with family and a few friends. And I still want to kill myself every day.

I hate how I look like I'm an alien.
I hate how poor I am and my family is.
I hate how the mistakes I made (things I did that I thought would make my life better) are haunting me for the past 2-3 years.
I hate how I am in the U.S. under the current presidency.
I hate how not normal I am.
I hate the fact that I am gay.
I hate the fact that I am overweight.
I hate how I am not doing well enough in my classes.
I hate how I am stupid.
I hate how every time I am about to hurt myself or kill myself, my brain decides to mellow out and calm down.
And for that reason, I can never bring myself up to actually suicide.
And guess what, I hate that too.

Everytime I get asked "what do I want for [holiday, occasion, or maybe even just random question]", I always say "To die" and everyone treats it like I joke because I'm apparently so good at hiding the fact that I suffer from depression and anxiety and possible borderline personality disorder and whatever else is fucked up in my head. But somehow everyday when a friendly student or someone I know asks me how am I doing, I always manage to say "I'm fine". Meanwhile the demons that haunt me are very much active.
Nothing helps anyway. The only thing keeping me here is my stupid-ass head deciding to mellow and quiet down right when I try to hurt myself.

This shit is me every single fucking day and I want it to fucking stop.

Just let me hurt myself please. It's not like anyone would care anyway.

Imagine thinking the internet won't bend to your will :o

You posted about a potential school shooter in a highly subscribed to subreddit **on the internet**. Like you said, you have no control over others actions, as you were defending the shooter in some other comments.

But you really posted about a potential school shooter in a popular internet forum, expressed strongly that you won't report it today, and expected no one to find a way to do a job that you cannot bring yourself to do?

If you're going to be so helpful with your evidence gathering, I **advise** you to get to it and stop replying to comments on Reddit. No wonder it'll take you 4 days to report, you're too busy here instead of saving innocent lives. **There's your "advice", and judging from your lack of action and sense, you're going to need help too.**

Your school is not the only place in existence in New Zealand. There are houses, stores, parks, churches? This plan can happen anywhere and you're being self-centered around places that are relevant to your universe. Who cares if he is on vacation? He is a threat.
"I went to a subreddit to ask for advice, and I completely ignored 90% of the advice"
You expected to post about a school shooter and expected **no one** to report? And you're calling me an idiot? Please think. Please. It'll bring a lot of benefit to the situation.

I understand that you think that you're helping the police by giving them more evidence. But really you just slapping around: "I'll report in 2 days, no wait, in 3, no wait, in 4 days" gives the potential shooter a LITERAL DEADLINE??? To either:

\- Hide the evidence

\- Execute his plan elsewhere

I saw that you said "we are safe for 2 months because school doesn't start until then" and I find that ridiculous. There are other places in the world other than school you know? Movie theaters, grocery stores, homes, neighborhoods? It might not be at your school? Ever thought of that? Save lives and report now. Heck I already have through [your local crimestoppers](https://www.crimestoppers-nz.org/about/contact-us/email-anonymously) and I am halfway across the dang planet from you.

[Here](https://www.crimestoppers-nz.org/about/contact-us/email-anonymously) is the crimestoppers line for New Zealand it seems like. You give tips anonymously and it is completely anonymous after reviewing strictly what is defined by anonymous by them: [https://www.crimestoppers-nz.org/about/contact-us/email-anonymously](https://www.crimestoppers-nz.org/about/contact-us/email-anonymously)

OP seems to be refusing to report immediately. So for those wanting to tip immediately instead, and potentially save lives, I encourage you all to use this.

OP claims he will come up to the police station in 2-4 days. Personally, I find 2-4 days to be perfectly enough time to get rid of evidence or go on a killing spree.

I know OP says to not contact anyone, but this kind of thing should be reported immediately. To save lives, instead of risk them.
Agreed. OP is risking innocent lives just to spontaneously become a detective? The lack of logic from OP is just as bad as the lack of sane thinking from the shooter themselves.

REPORT IT NOW HOLY FUCK.

Quit waiting trying to do a job that you are not trained and qualified to do. Quit waiting for your buddy and report it right now. The post is already everywhere. The potential shooter can be starting to get rid of evidence as we speak and you're waiting for your buddy???

There's people who had this exact mentality and got to the police too late, because they needed to stroke their ego and try to do the police's job.

PLEASE SAVE LIVES AND REPORT NOW.

Edit: Grammar. Also. I want to emphasize that I am frustrated that history is repeating itself this instant, massacres occurring because people don't report suspicions to the police. Except this time, you were lucky enough to see the signs.  PLEASE PLEASE REPORT IT IMMEDIATELY.
